title: feat(fields): every record reference shows a hover card with the target's declared highlights
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDSnrkE4tAZzd2PBTPkxkA8)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：控制台里每个记录引用（列表/放大表的关系列、详情列的 lookup chip、记录页关联列紧凑行的名字）悬停 400 ms 或按空格，会浮出一张卡：目标对象图标与名称、记录名（点开方式与点引用本身一致）、对象声明的 highlightFields（去掉名字字段，最多 6 个），用目标对象自己的字段渲染器画。Esc、移开或失焦即收起，同时只开一张。
- 为什么改：看被引用记录的要点原来只能钻进去再回来；悬浮卡给一眼，不跳转，不撑开宿主布局。
- 风险与回滚：卡只在展示时读一次记录（findOne，$expand 只含卡上画的引用字段），按记录缓存、数据总线通知变更即作废；列表渲染零请求。卡挂在 document.body 上，宿主 DOM 只多 Radix 的状态属性。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/RecordHoverCard.tsx`（读取缓存、highlightFields 取舍、空格/Esc）；`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` 的 `ReferencedRecordLink`；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 紧凑行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/RecordHoverCard-27604.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.compactHoverCard-27604.test.tsx`，预期 14 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（新增公开导出 `RecordHoverCard`，Clause-② yes (widening)，席位按车道规则安排合同审查）。

Fixes #27604

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- New `RecordHoverCard` in `@object-ui/fields` (`ui/packages/fields/src/RecordHoverCard.tsx`), exported with `RecordHoverCardProps` and `RecordHoverCardObjectDef`. It wraps the element that names a record and, after a 400 ms hover or Space on the focused reference, shows a card portalled to `document.body`: the target object's icon (`LazyIcon`) and label (`useObjectLabel`), the record's name as a link (the host's `recordHref`; a plain click goes to the host's open path, or the caller's `onOpen`), and the object's declared `highlightFields` drawn through `getCellRenderer`. Focus alone does not open it; Esc, pointer-out and blur close it; one card is open at a time; a reference inside a card gets no card of its own.
- Highlights: the declared `highlightFields` only, filtered to names the object defines, minus the name field (`resolveNameField`) and minus fields the viewer may not read (`checkField(..., 'read')`), then capped at six. Nothing is derived: an object that declares none shows the name and the object label. Empty values are not drawn, as on the record header strip.
- Read: nothing until a card is shown, then one `findOne(object, id)` with `$expand` naming only the readable reference fields among the highlights. Answers are cached per record in the module (at most 200), and a `notifyDataChanged` for the record drops its entry; an open card re-reads in place. The cache is local to the component; the data-layer dedupe of the sibling performance card is not duplicated.
- Wired in two places:
  - `ReferencedRecordLink` (the anchor `LookupCellRenderer` draws for every linkable lookup / master-detail value), which covers a relation column in a list, a related list's table and its enlarged view, and a lookup in the details column. The cell hands over the target definition it already reads (`refSchema`) and its display name.
  - The name in a compact related row (`RelatedList`'s compact face), with the list's own data source and object definition; the card's title opens the row through the same `handleRowClick` as the name.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/RecordHoverCard-27604.test.tsx` (11), through `LookupCellRenderer` under a real `SchemaRendererProvider` and `RelatedRecordActionsProvider`: a lead (eight declared, name first: six shown, name dropped, option label and currency drawn), a contact with no status field (exactly its four, one read with `$expand: ['account']`, the inner lookup has no card of its own), a product, an object declaring no `highlightFields` (name + object label, no list), an unreadable record (reference name + object label), 200 rows drawn with zero reads then one read per shown record and a cache hit on re-hover, the hover delay, focus alone shows nothing while Space shows and Esc hides, one card at a time, the host's markup unchanged apart from Radix's state attributes, and the title opening through the host with no click reaching the row.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/RecordHoverCard.fieldAccess-27604.test.tsx` (1): a highlight the viewer may not read is neither drawn nor expanded.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.compactHoverCard-27604.test.tsx` (3): hovering a compact row's name shows the row's declared highlights with no read on row render and the row's markup unchanged; Space shows the card without opening the row and Esc hides it; the card title opens the row through `onRowClick`.

## Acceptance notes

- Placement measured against the card's file surface: the lookup renderer and `ReferencedRecordLink` live in `@object-ui/fields`, and `@object-ui/fields` depends on `@object-ui/components`, not the reverse. A card that draws the target's values with `getCellRenderer` therefore lives in `fields`; nothing under `ui/packages/components/src/ui/**` changed. The seat amended the claim's file surface to match.
- One edit point covers three of the card's surfaces: `LookupCellRenderer` is the renderer `DetailSection`, `RelatedList`'s table and `ObjectGrid`'s lookup columns all resolve through. `plugin-list` and `plugin-grid` needed no change.
- Out of the named surfaces and unchanged: a grid's primary name link (the row's own record) and `referenceVia` pointer cells. Those can take `RecordHoverCard` later the same way the compact row does.
- `RelatedList.tsx`'s docblock region touched by the in-flight #27793 is not edited; this PR changes only the compact face's row.
- Screenshots (card Acceptance 2) are on the never-merged branch `claude/issue-27604-evidence` (a8b2da2d), folder `evidence/27604/`: a relation cell in the Projects list, a lookup chip in a record's details column, and a compact related row whose object declares no `highlightFields` (name and object label only), with the two Playwright scripts and a README. HotCRM is a separate repository this session cannot reach, so they are taken on `examples/app-showcase` at 49504eb8, whose `showcase_account` declares `highlightFields: ['status', 'industry', 'annual_revenue']`.
- Live readings from the same run: 0 by-id reads after the Projects list rendered, 1 read (`/data/showcase_account/<id>`) after one hover on an Account cell; on the compact row, Space on the focused name showed one card without navigating and Esc left none.
- The epic seat's console check (Acceptance 3) follows once CI is green.
